replacement_method: Generated north-facing overhead artwork, continuous rotation around a registered central pivot. Embedded hyrax pilots rotate together with the hull. This is not a new set of 32 independent perspective views.
verification: tests/graphics_repairs_v05_test.gd: all ten aircraft at 32 heading samples plus real movement commands in eight directions; transparent background and padded bounds checked. Runtime shadows and projectile origins use the same orientation.
superseded_source_findings: Hyrax interceptor and bomber frames assigned to eastward movement visibly point northwest.
Several northern and southern frames repeat similar views; column remapping alone cannot repair the atlas.
Generated north-facing hyrax replacement initially contained south-facing pilots; a revised draft shows backs of heads.
Replacement hyrax and owl atlases retain opaque backgrounds and are not approved for runtime use.
All generated replacement atlases remain outside runtime assets pending complete directional, alpha and registration review.
code_fix: Moving aircraft hull and pilot use body_direction (actual displacement), rather than facing possibly overwritten by target acquisition.
acceptance_criteria: Nose, pilot gaze and travel direction agree in every heading.
North shows pilot rear, south shows pilot face, lateral views match the nose.
All active animation rows checked, including attack and mirrored headings.
Transparent background, stable pivot and no clipping.
Actual in-game flight and turning capture reviewed before release.
